title: The Sopranos - Patsy and Burt failed extortion attempt at "Starbucks"
summary: A scene from The Sopranos in which two old-school mobsters try to extort a Starbucks and learn that electronic payments leave an indisputable record of sales.
why: HN posts it jokingly in threads about payments, taxes and cash, as a funny illustration of how digital transactions make low-level shenanigans harder.

quote.text: This is always a funny video clip about electronic payments making low level shenanigans more difficult.
